name: jsxj
description: JSXJ (Java + JSX): syntax highlighting and a language server (diagnostics, completion, hover, go to definition).

jsxj.server.jar.description: Path to jsxj-lsp.jar. Empty: the jar bundled with the extension (server/jsxj-lsp.jar).

jsxj.javaPath.description: The java executable that runs the server (JDK 17+; javac diagnostics need a JDK, not a JRE).

jsxj.sourceRoots.description: Extra folders with .java sources for javac and component lookup (relative to the workspace root). Folders inside the workspace are found automatically.

jsxj.classpath.description: Jars or class folders for javac, e.g. the jreact-core jar, when its sources are not in the workspace.
